title: 亻 person (单人旁)
intro: 亻 is 人 (person) squeezed onto the left: a slanting stroke, then a vertical. Characters with 亻 are about people, what they do, and how they relate: living, resting, trusting, borrowing. You already know 你 and 他; this unit adds twelve more.

ex.p: wǒ men xiū xi yī xià ba
ex.en: Let's rest for a moment.

ex.p: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn lǎo shī
ex.en: This is our new teacher.

ex.p: nǐ zhù zài nǎr
ex.en: Where do you live?

ex.p: zhù zài zhèr hěn fāng biàn
ex.en: Living here is very convenient.

ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ yī dìng néng zuò dào
ex.en: I believe you can do it.

ex.p: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang zuò fàn
ex.en: I cook every evening.

ex.p: wǒ de zuò yè hái méi zuò wán
ex.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.

ex.zh: 我身体不太舒服，想休息一天。
ex.p: wǒ shēn tǐ bù tài shū fu xiǎng xiū xi yī tiān
ex.en: I don't feel well, I want to rest for a day.

ex.p: duō yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ hǎo
ex.en: Exercise is good for your health.

ex.zh: 我身体不太舒服，想休息一天。

ex.en: I don't feel well, I want to rest for a day.

ex.p: wǒ men xiū xi yī xià ba
ex.en: Let's rest for a moment.

ex.p: wǒ yé ye qù nián tuì xiū le
ex.en: My grandpa retired last year.

ex.p: wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ yī dìng néng zuò dào
ex.en: I believe you can do it.

ex.p: kě yǐ yòng xìn yòng kǎ ma
ex.en: Can I use a credit card?

ex.p: tā gěi mā ma xiě le yī fēng xìn
ex.en: He wrote a letter to his mom.

ex.zh: 这件衣服很漂亮，但是太贵了。
ex.p: zhè jiàn yī fu hěn piào liang dàn shì tài guì le
ex.en: This piece of clothing is pretty, but too expensive.

ex.zh: 他不但会说汉语，还会写汉字。
ex.p: tā bù dàn huì shuō hàn yǔ hái huì xiě hàn zì
ex.en: He can not only speak Chinese, but also write characters.

ex.p: qǐng wèn zhè gè zuò wèi yǒu rén ma
ex.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

ex.p: zhè wèi shì wǒ men de xīn lǎo shī
ex.en: This is our new teacher.

ex.zh: 这件衣服很漂亮，但是太贵了。
ex.p: zhè jiàn yī fu hěn piào liang dàn shì tài guì le
ex.en: This piece of clothing is pretty, but too expensive.

ex.zh: 这家店的东西又便宜又好。
ex.p: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xi yòu pián yi yòu hǎo
ex.en: This shop's things are cheap and good.

ex.p: zhù zài zhèr hěn fāng biàn
ex.en: Living here is very convenient.

ex.zh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de bǐ yòng yī xià ma
ex.en: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

ex.zh: 我想去图书馆借几本书。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng qù tú shū guǎn jiè jǐ běn shū
ex.en: I want to borrow some books from the library.

ex.p: tā cháng de hěn xiàng tā bà ba
ex.en: He looks a lot like his dad.

ex.p: nǐ hǎo xiàng bù tài gāo xìng
ex.en: You seem a bit unhappy.

休.h: 亻 + 木 (a person leaning on a tree)

位.h: 亻 + 立 (a person standing in place)

texts.title: 读一读 · 亻 person (单人旁)

lines.zh: 我住在学校旁边，去上课很方便。
lines.p: wǒ zhù zài xué xiào páng biān qù shàng kè hěn fāng biàn

lines.zh: 我们学校的图书馆很大，我常常去那儿借书。
lines.p: wǒ men xué xiào de tú shū guǎn hěn dà wǒ cháng cháng qù nàr jiè shū

lines.zh: 上个星期我身体不太舒服，在家休息了三天。
lines.p: shàng gè xīng qī wǒ shēn tǐ bù tài shū fu zài jiā xiū xi le sān tiān

lines.zh: 我的同学小张给我送来了作业，还给我做了一碗汤。
lines.p: wǒ de tóng xué xiǎo zhāng gěi wǒ sòng lái le zuò yè hái gěi wǒ zuò le yī wǎn tāng

lines.zh: 我相信，她是我最好的朋友。
lines.p: wǒ xiāng xìn tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you

exercises.why: 注 has 氵; living is what people do (亻)
休 (rest) and 体 (body) differ by one stroke
更 is only the sound part
象 = elephant; resemble needs 亻
门 = door; the plural adds 亻
